# Installation Instructions
- all installations should be done in a virtual environment (venv using UV under unix(NOT windows))
- windows installtion with venv and conda 
- installed files should be gitignored (see .gitignore) because it's system-dependent

# running the experiment
- always use the venv (uv venv, source .venv/bin/activate)
- all packages should be installed in the venv
- alwys update the install script if new packages are added
